title: ToolMind Technical Report: A Large-Scale, Reasoning-Enhanced Tool-Use Dataset
authors_zh: Chen Yang、Ran Le、Yun Xing、Zhenwei An、Zongchao Chen、Wayne Xin Zhao、Yang Song、Tao Zhang
paper_type_zh: 开放后训练数据集与构造研究
one_line: ToolMind constructs a function graph, simulates realistic interactions, and filters each turn before retaining complete self-corrective trajectories.
ToolMind 用函数图驱动多代理交互，并在逐轮过滤后发布 16 万条合成与 20 万条增强工具记录。
why: Trajectory-level acceptance can hide a wrong intermediate tool call whose error propagates through every later turn.
inclusion_reason: ToolMind is a public Track 01 object containing multi-turn conversations and tool definitions and is explicitly consumed by tool-use SFT.
domains: English function calling and multi-turn tool use

title: Problem
问题
html:
Trajectory-level acceptance can hide a wrong intermediate tool call whose error propagates through every later turn.

ToolMind constructs a function graph, simulates realistic interactions, and filters each turn before retaining complete self-corrective trajectories. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives fine-grained turn-level checks plus trajectory-level quality filtering; the direct output is ToolMind, consumed by tool-use SFT rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2511.15718; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data ToolMind at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Nanbeige/ToolMind; scale 160,000 synthetic and 200,000 augmented open-source tool-use instances; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

只在整条轨迹结束时验收会掩盖错误的中间工具调用，后续步骤可能在错误状态上继续生成。

该工作按参数关系构建函数图，模拟用户、助手和工具交互，再逐轮过滤并保留自纠正轨迹。 判定边界是记录能否通过“细粒度逐轮检查与整轨迹质量过滤”并成为工具使用监督微调的输入；直接产物是 ToolMind，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2511.15718，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 ToolMind，规模是16 万条合成工具记录和 20 万条增强开放记录；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ToolMind constructs a function graph, simulates realistic interactions, and filters each turn before retaining complete self-corrective trajectories. Relative to tool datasets checked only at the final trajectory level, it changes the reusable target to multi-turn conversations and tool definitions and makes fine-grained turn-level checks plus trajectory-level quality filtering the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: more than 20,000 tools linked by parameter correlations plus augmented public tool data. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: a multi-agent simulator writes user, assistant, and tool turns over a function graph. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as multi-turn conversations and tool definitions and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply fine-grained turn-level checks plus trajectory-level quality filtering. Output and transition: Passing records form 160,000 synthetic and 200,000 augmented open-source tool-use instances stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for tool-use SFT and compare with tool datasets checked only at the final trajectory level. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是由参数关系连接的两万余个工具及增强的公开工具数据。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由多代理模拟器生成用户、助手与工具轮次。输出是按“多轮会话与工具定义”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行细粒度逐轮检查与整轨迹质量过滤。输出是通过检查的16 万条合成工具记录和 20 万条增强开放记录，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于工具使用监督微调，并与只在轨迹末端检查的工具数据比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: ToolMind-trained models improve over the paper's baselines on tau-bench, tau2-bench, and BFCL-v4; the comparison supports turn-level filtering but does not isolate every augmented source. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 160,000 synthetic and 200,000 augmented open-source tool-use instances and exposes actual fields multi-turn conversations and tool definitions; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 2393 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：使用 ToolMind 训练的模型在 tau-bench、tau2-bench 与 BFCL-v4 上优于论文基线；结果支持逐轮过滤，但未隔离每个增强来源。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含16 万条合成工具记录和 20 万条增强开放记录，实际字段是“多轮会话与工具定义”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 2393 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is tool datasets checked only at the final trajectory level. The paper changes the reusable object by making multi-turn conversations and tool definitions explicit and coupling it to fine-grained turn-level checks plus trajectory-level quality filtering. That is a direction signal because another team can train tool-use SFT from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是只在轨迹末端检查的工具数据。真正变化是把“多轮会话与工具定义”显式化，并与“细粒度逐轮检查与整轨迹质量过滤”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练工具使用监督微调，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When judge models can miss semantically wrong calls that match the expected syntax, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because synthetic user behavior and function graphs may not reflect production failures, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve Apache-2.0 and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果评审模型可能漏过语法正确但语义错误的调用，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于合成用户行为与函数图未必覆盖生产环境故障，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 Apache-2.0 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building tool-use SFT, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay fine-grained turn-level checks plus trajectory-level quality filtering. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建工具使用监督微调的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放细粒度逐轮检查与整轨迹质量过滤，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: ToolMind constructs a function graph, simulates realistic interactions, and filters each turn before retaining complete self-corrective trajectories.
  • Data object: 160,000 synthetic and 200,000 augmented open-source tool-use instances; each record exposes multi-turn conversations and tool definitions.
  • Author and selector: a multi-agent simulator writes user, assistant, and tool turns over a function graph; retention uses fine-grained turn-level checks plus trajectory-level quality filtering.
  • Evidence anchor: ToolMind-trained models improve over the paper's baselines on tau-bench, tau2-bench, and BFCL-v4; the comparison supports turn-level filtering but does not isolate every augmented source.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for tool-use SFT; first audit judge models can miss semantically wrong calls that match the expected syntax and synthetic user behavior and function graphs may not reflect production failures.

• 定位：ToolMind 用函数图驱动多代理交互，并在逐轮过滤后发布 16 万条合成与 20 万条增强工具记录。
  • 数据对象：16 万条合成工具记录和 20 万条增强开放记录，单条记录包含多轮会话与工具定义。
  • 生成与筛选：多代理模拟器生成用户、助手与工具轮次，并依据细粒度逐轮检查与整轨迹质量过滤保留。
  • 证据锚点：使用 ToolMind 训练的模型在 tau-bench、tau2-bench 与 BFCL-v4 上优于论文基线；结果支持逐轮过滤，但未隔离每个增强来源。
  • 复用决定：适合工具使用监督微调；先审计评审模型可能漏过语法正确但语义错误的调用和合成用户行为与函数图未必覆盖生产环境故障。
